app.title: vicinopoli
app.description: vicinopoli is your neighbourhood's square: read and write messages, voice and photos with the people who live near you. Free, no account.

update.available: A new version is available. Reload to update.

address.title: Where are you?
address.intro: Your neighbourhood's square: messages, voice and photos from the people who live near you. Free, no account.

composer.empty: No messages yet. Be the first!
composer.scopeLabel: Who do you want to reach
composer.quotaHelpBody: When you're a new neighbour, you can only publish a few posts per day. That's how we keep out spam and abuse without asking you to sign up.
composer.quotaHelpTrust: Over time your neighbour gains trust and the limit goes up.

pseudonym.title: What should we call you?
pseudonym.hint: A name to sign your messages.

consent.title: Anonymous statistics
consent.body: May we collect anonymous statistics and share them with Google for campaigns? Your address is never recorded.
